title: Wait for each other
summary: Two threads meet: neither goes on until both have arrived.
hints: Two semaphores at 0: A does `post(a_arrived); wait(b_arrived)`, B does `post(b_arrived); wait(a_arrived)`. Post FIRST, then wait: waiting first would deadlock both.
Print `before` before the meeting and `after` after it. The two `before` lines may come in either order, but both come before any `after`.
